speaker: SYLVIE
description: Sylvie is a young female bonded companion who communicates via a bright, high-pitched, childlike telepathic mind-voice. Her timbre is sweet, light, and expressive, delivered at a lively, energetic pace with an affectionate and playful baseline. Delivery should capture her innocent, feisty personality, seamlessly transitioning between cheerful enthusiasm, petulant pouting, and protective urgency.
